additions.reason: The central concept of the entire Torah. 'עִקַּר הַגְּבוּרָה' — gevurah is the subject of the Torah's teaching. It is the dominant node of Package 1, equated via bechina language to the heart, to conquering the yetzer hara, and to Samson's feats. Not in dataset for Torah 249.

The heart is stated as the seat/essence of gevurah: 'עִקַּר הַגְּבוּרָה בְּהַלֵּב'. This is a definitional bechina — gevurah IS the heart (the heart is the bechina / locus of gevurah). The Torah confirms this again at the end: 'שֶׁבָּא לוֹ חֹזֶק וְתֹקֶף גְּבוּרָה בַּלֵּב'. The heart and gevurah are parallel expressions of the same inner reality.
additions.source_quote: עִקַּר הַגְּבוּרָה – בְּהַלֵּב... שֶׁבָּא לוֹ חֹזֶק וְתֹקֶף גְּבוּרָה בַּלֵּב

additions.reason: Explicitly equated to gevurah via 'וְזֶה בְּחִינַת': 'וְזֶה בְּחִינַת אֵיזֶהוּ גִּבּוֹר הַכּוֹבֵשׁ אֶת יִצְרוֹ'. The conquering of the yetzer hara is not a result of gevurah (that would be eitza) — it IS gevurah. The outer battle (conquering the physical war) and the inner battle (conquering the yetzer) are two expressions of the same thing. Bechina, not eitza.
additions.source_quote: וְזֶה בְּחִינַת (אבות פ"ד): אֵיזֶהוּ גִּבּוֹר הַכּוֹבֵשׁ אֶת יִצְרוֹ

additions.reason: Explicitly equated to gevurah via 'וְזֶה בְּחִינַת': 'וְזֶה בְּחִינַת גְּבוּרוֹת שִׁמְשׁוֹן'. Samson's feats are held up as the paradigmatic expression of heart-rooted gevurah — the spirit of God stirring him in the camp of Dan and clothing him in strength is the same phenomenon as any person whose heart is strong and fears nothing. Samson's story is not a cause or result — it is the bechina, the manifestation of the same reality.
additions.source_quote: וְזֶה בְּחִינַת גְּבוּרוֹת שִׁמְשׁוֹן... דְּהַיְנוּ שֶׁבָּא לוֹ חֹזֶק וְתֹקֶף גְּבוּרָה בַּלֵּב

potential_eitza_nodes_not_included_in_pa.reason_excluded: The spirit of God is described as PRODUCING gevurah in Samson: 'צָלְחָה עָלָיו רוּחַ ה' וְלָבַשׁ גְּבוּרָה'. This is eitza (cause-and-effect: ruach Hashem → gevurah), not bechina. Ruach Hashem is not 'the same thing as' gevurah — it is what clothes a person in gevurah. Therefore it does NOT belong in Package 1 but would be a separate node connected by an eitza edge.
